title: Minor World Improvements
description: Minor World Improvements is a vanilla-style world generation mod that adds small natural details to Minecraft’s overworld.
body:
### **Minor World Improvements**

**Minor World Improvements** is a **vanilla-style world generation mod** that makes Minecraft’s overworld feel **more alive, varied, and naturally detailed without changing the core Minecraft experience too much**. Instead of adding huge fantasy structures or completely replacing vanilla terrain, the mod focuses on small environmental improvements that make biomes feel less empty and more believable.

The goal of the mod is to **improve areas** of the world that often feel **plain, repetitive, or unfinished**, while still keeping the world recognizable as Minecraft. Forests gain natural paths and stone formations, savannas receive termite mounds and stone structures, jungles and taigas get small rocky details, and mountain biomes become more visually varied with improved stone textures and scattered stone patches.
